text: لَبَّیْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّیْكَ، لَبَّیْكَ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَكَ لَبَّیْكَ، اِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ
لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَاشَرِیْكَ لَكَ۔ لَبَّیْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّیْكَ، لَبَّیْكَ لَا شَرِیْكَ
لَكَ لَبَّیْكَ، اِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَاشَرِیْكَ لَكَ۔
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّیْكَ، لَبَّیْكَ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَكَ لَبَّیْكَ، اِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ
لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَاشَرِیْكَ لَكَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ. اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ.

اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. May Allah enable all of us to go there over and over again, Ameen. So if not this year, Insha'Allah next year, right? Don't worry. So make a plan, start saving up for it,
and Insha'Allah don't just rely on your own means, rely on Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala; He can take you there.
SubhanAllah. All right, so let's begin properly. اِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلّٰهِ، نَحْمَدُهٗ وَنَسْتَعِیْنُهٗ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهٗ، وَنَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ شُرُوْرِ اَنْفُسِنَا
وَمِنْ سَیِّئٰتِ اَعْمَالِنَا، مَنْ یَّهْدِهِ اللّٰهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهٗ، وَمَنْ یُّضْلِلْهُ فَلَا هَادِیَ لَهٗ، وَاَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَهٗ،
وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ۔ اَعُوْذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّیْطٰنِ الرَّجِیْمِ۔ بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ۔ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِیْ صَدْرِیْ ۙ وَیَسِّرْ لِیْۤ
اَمْرِیْ ۙ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّنْ لِّسَانِیْ ۙ یَفْقَهُوْا قَوْلِیْ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ فَقِّهْنَا فِی الدِّیْنِ. May Allah give us the correct understanding of our deen, Ameen. So with that,
Insha'Allah let's begin our session. Today's session will be more like an orientation day. The name of the course is 'Hajj: Journey of a Lifetime' because it is, SubhanAllah, a very
beautiful journey, and it is a journey of a lifetime for some, and Alhamdulillah some people are able to go over and over again. May Allah accept everyone's efforts and may Allah accept
everyone's wishes and desires to go for Hajj as well, Ameen. Because not everyone is able to go, but Alhamdulillah we all, being believers, we wish to go there, right? But SubhanAllah,

someone was mentioning something very powerful: that there are three types of people when it comes to Hajj. There are three types of people when it comes to Hajj: one type, they can afford and they also want to go;
second type, they cannot afford, but they still want to go; third type, they can afford, but they don't go, they delay it, they
don't really, really want to go, SubhanAllah. So may Allah save us from becoming from the third category, Ameen. So Alhamdulillah for this opportunity that we are able to
go, and Alhamdulillah after two years Hajj has opened up—not fully, but Alhamdulillah it has opened up for many people, Alhamdulillah. So you can say
slightly a door has opened. Alhamdulillah there is hope that Insha'Allah in coming years it's going to be back to normal or even Insha'Allah better for everyone. So Alhamdulillah when we
have got this opportunity, when we know that Hajj is open, that Insha'Allah we should increase in our du'as so that we can actually get there.
And whenever Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala gives us the opportunity, we should just avail it right away before it's too late.

So let's begin by praising Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala that we are still alive. Let's praise Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala that we are Muslims. Let's praise Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala that Alhamdulillah He enabled

us to join this session, because Insha'Allah when we learn about Hajj, the goal is that we love Hajj more, and when we are going to yearn for Hajj more, Insha'Allah the du'as are going to come from our hearts, right?
All right, so let's praise Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَتّٰی تَرْضٰی، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ اِذَا رَضِیْتَ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ بَعْدَ الرِّضٰی. O Allah, for You is praise
until You're pleased with our praise, and for You is praise when You are pleased, and for You is praise after You're pleased. اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ كَثِیْرًا.
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ. And Alhamdulillah we are going to begin with this beautiful du'a because this is such a beautiful du'a and very powerful du'a which talks about
four important things. We're asking Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala for four things in this du'a: بَرَكَات (barakat),
رَحْمَة (rahmat), فَضْل (fadl), and رِزْق (rizq). اَللّٰهُمَّ ابْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ، وَرَحْمَتِكَ، وَفَضْلِكَ، وَرِزْقِكَ. O Allah, give us in abundance—what?
From Your blessings, Your mercy, Your favors, and Your sustenance. Ameen. May Allah accept this du'a for all of us. Isn't it a beautiful du'a?
It covers pretty much everything, SubhanAllah. So Insha'Allah with this we are going to Insha'Allah hope that Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala blesses us and also blesses us in our knowledge about
Hajj, Ameen. So the question is: why do you want to learn about Hajj? Like why this year? Why in 2022? Why do you want to learn about Hajj?
Very good, Sister Afreen. Sister Afreen is saying to perform the Hajj persona—beautiful. Anything else? Why do you want to learn about Hajj?
So it becomes accepted. May Allah accept it from all the people who actually go and perform it, Ameen. To learn the right way so Allah accepts her Hajj—very good, Alhamdulillah. Any other reason?
For Hajj Mabroor, yes. To perform it like the Prophet Sallallahu Alayhi wa Sallam. For the acceptance. To know the importance in the right way—perfect.
Alhamdulillah. To know the wisdom behind this ibadah, so we can follow the way of Rasulullah Sallallahu Alayhi wa Sallam, so our effort and time is not wasted. Beautiful, well done.
Masha'Allah, all of you have really good ideas about why to go for Hajj. No one said that we want to be called Hajis; no one said that because, you know, everyone in my family they've

already been there, it was only me who was left. Alhamdulillah, that's good. So it seems like Alhamdulillah we are on the right page. Insha'Allah we're going to kind of tweak our intention a bit more Insha'Allah.
So what's the benefit of going for Umrah or Hajj? Rasulullah Sallallahu Alayhi wa Sallam said: The performance of Umrah is an expiation for the sins committed between one
Umrah and the next, right? And the reward of Hajj Mabroor is nothing except Jannah, SubhanAllah. Like it's like guaranteed, and
Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala's promises are true. So to fulfill the most important journey of one's life with sincerity for the sake of Allah, this should be our goal:
to fulfill the most important journey of one's life. You may travel here and there, but this is going to be Insha'Allah the best journey of your life, most important journey of your
life. So how are we supposed to take this journey? With sincerity, with ikhlas. Why? For the sake of Allah, only for the sake of Allah. Not for fame,
not for name, not for some games, not for some business. We should Insha'Allah keep it as pure as possible. Why? Because Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala commanded us to do that:
وَاَتِمُّوا الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ لِلّٰهِ ؕ 'And complete the Hajj and 'Umrah for Allah.' Like it doesn't say complete the Hajj and Umrah and it doesn't stop there, it says لِلّٰهِ:
do it for Allah, don't do it for any other reason. So Insha'Allah our goal is that we will Insha'Allah perform Hajj and Umrah whenever we get a chance only for the
pleasure of Allah, not the pleasure of people. Only for the pleasure of Allah, only we want Allah to be happy with us, only we want the approval of Allah, we don't want the approval of people.
So in order to do this, we need to ask ourselves a few questions, and one of them is: why am I going for Hajj? Like why? Why am I saving
up for Hajj? Why do I yearn to go for Hajj? What is the intention? And Insha'Allah we have to be truthful to ourselves in order to fix our intention. If
it's any other reason—and it sometimes is—then Insha'Allah this is the time to fix it before it's too late, before we perform it, right? So Insha'Allah if you
did not do your Hajj yet, and if you're going this year, then Insha'Allah this is the time to fix your intention.
And we've got to Insha'Allah make it a habit that we actually ask ourselves before doing other actions as well that: why am I praying? Why am I fasting?
Why am I giving sadaqah? All of these questions are going to help us keep our intentions purely for Allah, and this is a way to keep a check on our
intentions. So Insha'Allah just make it a habit: keep asking and keep giving yourself honest answers. Honest answers will help you Insha'Allah fix the intention issues,
because intention is something which is very risky; it keeps changing because shaytan is there, our nafs is there, right? And our influences are there, our company sometimes,
you know, they make us think something which is not correct. So Insha'Allah in order to keep ourselves away from all of this, and above and beyond from petty
reasons and petty purposes, we need to keep asking ourselves these questions so that we can fix our intention before it gets too late. And why the intention is so
important, this Hadith gives us a very good idea about it: A man came to Rasulullah and said: 'What do you think of a man who fights seeking reward and fame, what will he have?' Rasulullah
said: 'He will not have anything.' SubhanAllah, think about it: this person is putting his life at stake, yet he's not going to get anything out of it because he had
a double intention. So when people are going for Hajj, they need to remind themselves that it should only be for Allah, it should only be to please Allah, it
should not be to please people, it should not be for any other reason, it should not be for fame. So may Allah protect us from all wrong intentions. So
Insha'Allah in this course we will learn about different steps of Hajj, how to perform them, and also what are the rewards of each step, SubhanAllah.
So that is going to help us when we perform Hajj to enjoy Hajj, because a lot of times people take it as a burden, people take it as a chore or just a to-do list
item on their list when they're doing Hajj. But we want to do better, Insha'Allah. We don't want to do, you know, all the rituals of Hajj, all the rites of Hajj, just as
chores; we actually want to enjoy each and every step, and we will enjoy once we have knowledge about it, Insha'Allah. So we will know about every step of Hajj, and we will
try to perform it according to the Sunnah, Insha'Allah. We'll also learn about the do's and don'ts of Hajj, and then Insha'Allah we will prepare for Hajj before we go there. Even if
you're not going this year, we can still start preparing for it, because the more we are prepared, the better it is for us; the more we know, the more we will be able to, Insha'Allah,

have confidence when we're performing our Hajj. And people won't be able to confuse us, because a lot of times when you end up there with no knowledge or little knowledge, a lot of people are there to confuse
you because there are so many opinions, there's so many people, there's so many different backgrounds, and they just share whatever they have heard. A lot of times they also don't have knowledge,
and then they baffle you easily when you don't know enough. So Insha'Allah in this course you're going to know, so that we are not baffled,
Insha'Allah. And it is the promise of Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala that He will give us Jannah for Hajj Mabroor, and Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala's promises are
true. So Insha'Allah keep this in mind when you're going, and Insha'Allah you will come back sin-free as a newborn.
You will be just like a newborn baby with no sins on your record, SubhanAllah. So that is our biggest motivation when we go for Hajj, Alhamdulillah.
Hajj is an important part of our deen, so we should prepare for it spiritually and heartily, wholeheartedly Insha'Allah, right? So we should prepare our body,
we should prepare our finances, we should prepare our soul, we should prepare our intellect, we should prepare our heart, and Insha'Allah go well prepared for
Hajj, Insha'Allah. So now we are going to look at some of the tips given by Sister Shazia Nawaz: that how to prepare for Hajj. So there are eleven in total. So I hope

you have received your workbook from your course portal. So Insha'Allah download the workbook and Insha'Allah start jotting down all the points. If you don't have the workbook because you're not part of the course, it's okay, you can write down on a piece of paper.
All right, ready everyone? How many points were there again? Eleven in total. So let's just begin. Beautiful! First one: make du'a for ikhlas,
right? We have talked about that we should keep a check on our intention: it should be sincere, it should be khalis. Now we need to make du'a for it as well, because
our efforts are not enough; our efforts cannot take us anywhere. We always need Allah's help. So Insha'Allah first thing, ask Allah for help: make
du'a for ikhlas. There are so many du'as for ikhlas; Insha'Allah we're going to cover another one tomorrow, but today we're going to look at this beautiful one, because this talks about
our goal as well as we have learned about it earlier: only for Allah, right? So our goal is that we want to see Allah. So what is this beautiful du'a?

اَللّٰهُمَّ اَسْئَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ اِلٰی وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ اِلٰی لِقَائِكَ فِیْ غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَّلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُّضِلَّةٍ۔ What does that mean? 'O Allah, indeed I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and a longing to
meet You, in a manner that does not entail a calamity that will bring about harm or a trial that will cause deviation.'

Insha'Allah Sister Shazia Nawaz is going to explain this du'a to us towards the end of the session, Insha'Allah. So if you have any questions, you can keep those questions till the end. Point number two: in order to prepare for
Hajj, we should start observing our fara'id—mandatory prayers—and nawafil
properly. So not just observe them, but also observe them on time, follow all the prerequisites, and do everything properly. Start off with
proper wudu, Insha'Allah, and get in the mode of prayers. And SubhanAllah a lot of us, we do pray, but Insha'Allah now we need to move it up a
notch, we need to make it better. Especially when we are going for Hajj, we are going to a very beautiful place, we are going to visit sacred masajid: we
will be in Makkah, we will be in Madinah, Masjid al-Haram, Masjid an-Nabawi. So Insha'Allah we should try our best to pray beautifully and on time. A
lot of times it has been seen that people, they actually reach there, but whatever happens, sometimes they get sick or sometimes, you know, they don't have enough motivation to
go to the masjid to pray. That's something which is very sad, because we know about the rewards, right? The reward of praying in Masjid al-Haram is like praying 100,000 prayers elsewhere,
and the reward of praying in Masjid an-Nabawi is like praying 1,000 prayers elsewhere, SubhanAllah. The reward is that massive, so we
should not just take it lightly and not go to the masjid and thinking, 'We are still in the sacred bounds in our hotel room, so we'll still pray here.' If there's a genuine
problem, that's a different story. But if you're able to walk, if you're able to, you know, go down to the masjid, please do that; don't be lazy about it.
And Insha'Allah for that we should start making du'as right away: that may Allah grant us the ability to pray all five prayers in the sacred masajid when we are there,
whenever we are there, all five prayers in the masajid. Because what's the point of going there and still not getting all that reward which we can easily avail,
Insha'Allah? So make a plan for it and make du'as for it. And another tip which will help you is that Insha'Allah when you are going to be there,
whenever Insha'Allah, let's make du'a that we get there soon. So if you're not going for Hajj this year, you can Insha'Allah plan for an Umrah trip, all right Insha'Allah. So whenever you get there,

then Insha'Allah this is our goal: that we're going to pray all five prayers in the masjid. So the tip is that when you're going to go to the masjid from your hotel room, you're going to wear your abaya and hijab, isn't it?
Before you go there, like if you're going for Hajj this year, this is the time to Insha'Allah start preparing for it: so wear your abaya and hijab before salah anyways so that you

get in the mode of it, so that you know that: okay, I'll have to do it five times a day when I'm there, or even more, because sometimes you'll just go for tawaf, sometimes you will just go for tahajjud, sometimes you
so this way when you reach there, it won't be some extra task for you; you will already be kind of in routine for that.

And point number three is: get in the habit of reciting the Qur'an after every prayer. Why after every prayer? Because Insha'Allah in masajid there you will have a lot of time: you won't have to worry about
cooking food, you won't have to worry about serving anyone, you won't have to worry about work. So Alhamdulillah all the time you will have is for worship, so what is better

than reciting the Qur'an, right? Alhamdulillah. So when you are done with your tawaf, when you're done with your nawafil, what are you going to do? Instead of sitting and chitchatting, Insha'Allah open
your Mushaf and start praying. It's a good idea to have your own Mushaf Insha'Allah, even though in both masajid or in any masjid you go there, you will find Insha'Allah a
lot of Mushafs there; you can find the copies of the Qur'an there, you can easily grab them and recite. But if you have your own, then Insha'Allah you won't have to run around looking for them,
and you won't have to find the place where you stopped before, because you will have some type of bookmark Insha'Allah. So all of this will help you. So why recite a lot of Qur'an?

Because Insha'Allah for every letter you're getting ten rewards, and there's so many other benefits—you know all about them. If you are memorizing the Qur'an, then Alhamdulillah that's another beautiful opportunity
for you there, that you can just start reviewing it, and then Insha'Allah whatever you review you can Insha'Allah recite that in your salah in order to strengthen your memorization. Point
number four: give sadaqah. Try to give daily sadaqah while you're there. So take some extra money with you, and then Insha'Allah try to give as much sadaqah as
possible to different people, and Insha'Allah may Allah accept all of it from you. And when you're giving daily sadaqah, don't just forget about other
forms of sadaqah. So give money as well for sure, for sure, even if it's not a lot; but give every time you come across someone you think you should give to that person.
Otherwise you can buy meals and give people meals. A lot of people are waiting there hungry and it's very hard for them to go and grab food. So if you notice someone

who's hungry sitting outside the masjid and is not even able to go inside for whatever reason—sometimes there are some restrictions, children sometimes are not allowed to go to the masjid so the mothers they have to wait outside with the kids—so Insha'Allah if you have some snacks you can share with them.
Other types of acts of worship might as well for sadaqah Insha'Allah, and other forms of sadaqah would include giving Hajj gifts. So Insha'Allah your Hajj gift can include method:
how to perform Hajj. Because sadly it has been seen many people—not few, many people—when they reach there, they don't know what to do and they're just relying on their groups,
they're relying on their agents, they're relying on their group leads, they're relying on their scholars. It's good that you have a group lead, it's good that you have a good group you're with, but
you also need to know what to do, because sometimes people actually do get lost there from their group, and then they're very lost because they were just relying on their
leads; if leads are not there, then they are lost. So it's good that we know. But let's say the people around us, if they don't know, we can give them small pamphlets of authentic
ones: how to perform Hajj and whatnot. That would be a very beneficial gift. Also the du'a books are a very good idea; make sure they're authentic du'as. So Insha'Allah whatever you share, it should
be authentic. So sometimes it's not allowed for us to share literature inside the masjid, but it's okay to share outside the masjid or it's okay to share with the people you know. So

share such information with them, such gifts with them. And other things you can also give them, not just the books, but Insha'Allah anything else you buy from there you can give it to them; you can buy from your
homeland or wherever you're living and you can take the stuff with you and you give them as gifts. Also you will see that even though Zamzam water is right there, but you know some people are
so old and you know sometimes it's very tiring to go to the cooler, get the water. So what you can

question: do they give you food there? Yes, if you go with Hajj groups they arrange food for you, otherwise there are so many restaurants, people can order their own food as well whatever they like, and Allah knows best.
And then point number five: ask for forgiveness often in the morning and evening. Why? Because istighfar makes things easy, isn't it? So Insha'Allah don't ever
forget to ask for forgiveness. Don't ever think that: 'I'm here because I'm so noble and so holy; rest of the family members they never got a chance or they didn't get a chance
this year, so I'm better.' Never ever, right? So don't ever become arrogant and always stay humble and keep asking Allah for forgiveness, that
you know, with all our faults, with all our shortcomings, still
so we need to keep asking Allah for forgiveness. When you're asking for forgiveness, when you're saying, then
think about your shortcomings, think about your faults, think about your sins, and then remember the blessings and the benefits of istighfar when
you're doing that. And remember Rasulullah, he also would ask Allah to forgive him 70 to 100 times a day, SubhanAllah.
So where do we stand when we try to compare ourselves with this amazing action of our Prophet?
So 'Astaghfirullah' is the easiest way to ask Allah for forgiveness, but Alhamdulillah there are many beautiful adhkar, many beautiful du'as to ask Allah for forgiveness. So
Insha'Allah if you know more that's even better. And this is another beautiful one: اَللّٰهُمَّ—O Allah—اغْفِرْ لِیْ مَا قَدَّمْتُ—forgive for me whatever I have sent ahead—
وَمَا اَخَّرْتُ—and whatever I have delayed—وَمَا اَسْرَرْتُ—whatever I have hidden—وَمَا اَعْلَنْتُ—and whatever I have disclosed—وَمَا اَسْرَفْتُ—whatever I exceeded in—

وَمَا اَنْتَ اَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّیْ—and whatever You know more than me. This part is very important: many times we don't realize our mistakes, many times we don't know what we did, so this is Insha'Allah going to cover all of that.
اَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَاَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ۔ O
Allah, You are the Foremost and the Final; there is no deity except You. Such a beautiful du'a, Alhamdulillah, from Sahih Muslim. So if you can memorize it, you
can make it anywhere, it's not just for Hajj. It's just a beautiful way to ask Allah for forgiveness. And you all must have heard about Sayyid al-Istighfar, the
Chief of Istighfar. I hope you all already make it every morning and every evening, so Insha'Allah that's a very beautiful du'a for forgiveness. Point number six: bring yourself in

Hajj mode. Start living the Hajj before you get there. Start imagining yourself there. Start planning your days there. And you will be able to plan your days when you know what to do on what day, isn't it?
Otherwise how would you know what to do? It's not going to be a normal day when Hajj days begin, it'd be a total different routine. But how will you schedule yourself beforehand?
You will only be able to do it once you know what happens on which day. And why should we just get in the Hajj mode now? Because we know that
